items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A gentle cream that helps even the look of tone and redness, and a better fit than stronger actives while pregnant.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the look of a comfortable skin barrier and helps with lower-moisture skin.
A mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection that suits pregnancy-time skin.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and night, apply the azelaic cream and moisturizer in the evening, and finish with the mineral SPF each morning. I have left out the benzoyl peroxide wash and the retinoid and peel products for now, so please check any strong acne product with your midwife, doctor or a dermatologist, who is also the right person to see if the breakouts feel severe or persistent.
